title: Pangolin Map Viewer Implementation Plan
summary: Step-by-step implementation plan for building a Pangolin 3D map viewer with scene state decoding, frustum geometry, and event-driven rendering.
notes: Contains embedded interface specifications and architecture guidelines but is structured as a task-driven implementation runbook with 5 sequential tasks, each with file modifications, interfaces to produce, and numbered steps with checkboxes. References external spec document, indicating this is the implementation plan to execute that spec, not a standalone specification.
